thread:
amy_sales: Quick sync — Aurora (FinTech) POC kicks off. They want us to validate two variants: LlamaX-65B-qat and LlamaX-65B-ptq. Expecting ~1k QPS burst, but steady ~200 qps. Need: model compatibility check, perf numbers (p50/p95), and a pricing ballpark for Dedicated vs Hosted. Also they sent a security questionnaire that we should answer by EOD next Wed.

jordan_se: OK. For compatibility check do they need exact same ops (chat + streaming) or only generate endpoints?

amy_sales: Both chat + streaming and a batched embeddings call for search. They mentioned heavy prefix context (3k tokens typical).

mike_infra: Noted. QAT vs PTQ -> quantization differences matter for kernel selection. I'll run a quick dry-run on our infra. Can someone drop their sample prompt distribution?

jordan_se: Dropping a tiny sample set here.

jordan_se: ```
["summarize transaction logs 3k tokens..." , "detect fraud pattern in conversation...", "embed-512 for retrieval: short query list"]
```

mike_infra: Thanks. Running compatibility scan now. Using canonical scan tool:```bash
redwood-variant-scan --model LlamaX-65B-qat --seq-len 3072 --batch 8 --tests perf,ops,kv-cache
```

deploy-bot: scan started for LlamaX-65B-qat on pool:dedicated-us-west-2 (job id: scan-1895012345-qa) :gear:

mike_infra: FYI getting an intermittent CUDA OOM on qat at batch=16 when kv-cache warm. Dropping batch to 8 for stability. Will capture logs.

nina_prod: For pricing ballpark — is Dedicated monthly commit required for 1k qps bursts? We can propose hybrid: Dedicated baseline for steady 200 qps + burst routing to Hosted. That reduces commit size.

amy_sales: Yes customer prefers hybrid if cost OK. Can you do a rough delta between pure Hosted and hybrid? Need a slide for tomorrow.

nina_prod: Rough calc: Hosted only ~ $X/token (est) -> monthly ~$Y for expected traffic. Hybrid baseline reduces token unit cost ~25%. I'll prepare numbers.

kim_security: I grabbed their security questionnaire PDF. A few red flags: they require SOC2 Type II + key management options and audit logs retention 1 year. We have KMS/HSM integrations and audit logs but retention depends on plan. I'll draft answers and flag items that need legal/infra.

oliver_sre: Also check network topology for Private deployment — they asked about VPC peering latency guarantees. We should clarify cross-region fallbacks.

mike_infra: Scan results so far — LlamaX-65B-qat: passes ops compatibility, streaming OK, p50 ~ 120ms token, p95 ~ 380ms token at seq=1024 on g5. At seq=3072 p95 climbs to ~980ms. KV-cache warm improves p50 by ~20%. Attaching logs: https://internal.storage/reports/scan-1895012345-qat.log

mike_infra: LlamaX-65B-ptq: initial run failing on int8 matmul kernel mismatch on driver 535; need a kernel fallback or newer lib. Filing infra ticket.

jordan_se: Thanks — that kernel mismatch is consistent w/ other PTQ models on older stacks. Workaround: use PTQ variant with per-channel quant or fallback to 16-bit for that kernel. We'll recommend model owner provide PTQ variant compiled against our quant libs or use QAT if possible.

amy_sales: Great. Action items: (1) mike — finish scans for both variants and upload perf table; (2) nina — pricing slide + hybrid numbers; (3) kim — draft security answers and highlight legal. (4) jordan — write compatibility notes for the sales deck. Can everyone ack?

mike_infra: Ack, on it.

nina_prod: Ack, will have slide by 09:00 PST tomorrow.

kim_security: Ack, I'll ping legal on the retention wording.

jordan_se: Ack — I'll add compatibility callouts and fallback suggestions.

amy_sales: Thanks team. If PTQ fix drags, tell me so I can set customer expectations. :thumbsup:
